text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe's long slump had persisted, 
but with the arrival of autumn, it seemed 
she had finally weathered the worst of it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She gained a substantial amount of weight 
again, but this gain was accompanied by a 
sense of fulfillment. Agnes Tachyon also 
viewed it as part of her growth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Believing that things would continue to 
progress smoothly, she took on the 
challenge of the "St. Lite Kinen."
